song_craft: Voice: plain anupAya quatrain (question / MAyA-clause / conclusion). Alas kept mid-close (wonder-gasp, not grief).

lines: Worship, worshipper, worshipped — what talk of difference here, in the unsurpassed?
Transition indeed — of whom, by whom made, who walks the entry-course?
This Māyā — no different from consciousness-nonduality — stands as other, though different. Alas.
All is pure own-experience-nature. Vain thought — do not.
l3.sanskrit_cite: pūjapūjakapūjya bhedasaraṇiḥ keyam kathā anuttare saṃkrāmaḥ kila kasya kena vidadhe ko vā praveśakramaḥ māyeyam | na cidadvayāt paratayā bhinnā api aho vartate sarvam svānubhavasvabhāvavimalaṃ cintāṃ vṛthā mā kṛthāḥ
notes: mAyeyam both readings live (this-MAyA vs MAyA-this-illusion); bhinnA api attachment open (MAyA vs illusion) — BOUNDARY

verses.craft: Question (what difference?) -> MAyA stands-as-other-without-being-different (both opens visible: this-MAyA + though-different) -> conclusion (all-pure; vain-thought-donT). kila kept (indeed); alas kept (aho gasp).
verses.rejected: (a) resolving mAyeyam/bhinnA -> killed by BOUNDARY held-open x2. (b) cutting alas -> killed: gasp is camatkAra texture. (c) smoothing though-different away -> killed: tension is the doctrine.
verses.reads_against: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'māyeyam' is 'this Māyā' or 'Māyā, this [illusion]' is unresolved.", "Whether 'bhinnā api' (though different) modifies Māyā or the illusion is unresolved."]) / T1 / L0 (25 tokens, no forks; kila traced) / L2 / C1 essence+rasa+NOTE
